events.message: Build the textstats library and CLI
Contract fixed in CONTRACT.md. Remaining work is the Analyze library and the CLI with I/O tests. Both can proceed independently against the agreed interface.
Implement and test the textstats CLI
Implemented Stats and Analyze per contract; added table cases for empty, ASCII, Unicode whitespace/runes, newline counts, CRLF and malformed UTF-8. Verification remains.

Implemented Stats and Analyze in analyze.go with strings.Fields word counting, LF-based line counting, and utf8.RuneCountInString rune counting. Added table tests in analyze_test.go for empty input, ASCII, Unicode whitespace, trailing and multiple newlines, blank line, CRLF, and invalid UTF-8. Remaining work is to run the required Go test command and fix any failures.

Implemented Stats and Analyze in analyze.go and table tests in analyze_test.go for empty/ASCII input, Unicode whitespace and runes, line endings, CRLF, and invalid UTF-8. Required command `env TMPDIR=/workspace/scratch/eb95195a621a/tooling/tmp GOCACHE=/dev/shm/taskctl-go-cache /tmp/taskctl-go-1.27.4/go/bin/go test .` passed (ok example.com/textstats).
Implemented JSON CLI with stdin/file/-- handling, help and usage/read error exits; added CLI coverage and README. Requested go test ./cmd/textstats passes.
Implemented cmd/textstats CLI and tests plus README. Verified with env TMPDIR=/workspace/scratch/eb95195a621a/tooling/tmp GOCACHE=/dev/shm/taskctl-go-cache go test ./cmd/textstats: pass.
Both Luna branches finished, including the T2 to T5 replacement. Reviewing integrated source and executing CLI fixtures.

Reviewed both Luna implementations. go test -race ./... passes for library and CLI. Built CLI and verified Unicode stdin, empty stdin, a real leading-hyphen filename via --, missing-file exit 1, and usage exit 2. T4 became available only after T3 and replacement T5 completed.
